coverage: Named roster: FETCHED — the free Death House PDF on media.wizards.com (under its "Curse of Strahd Introductory Adventure.pdf" filename; the "Death House.pdf" name 404s), the Settlement Tracker PDF on media.dndbeyond.com, SRD 5.1 and SRD 5.2.1 (both read whole, both negative for settlement description and for read-aloud/boxed text), five D&D Beyond "Encounter of the Week" columns and eight official dndbeyond.com preview/excerpt/design articles, plus the open 2024 Free Rules "The Basics" section. BLOCKED — Lost Mine of Phandelver on D&D Beyond (every /sources/dnd/lmop/ path redirects to a claim page), replaced by the official "Visit Phandalin" article which reprints the published Phandalin boxed text with a "Source: Dragon of Icespire Peak" line, and by the Phandalin Post handout whose text is reproduced in a second official article; Dragon+ via Wayback (raw captures of dragonmag.com return a JavaScript shell with no article body, so no Dragon+ claim was written); the DMs Guild "Style Guide Resources" page (403, no Wayback capture), so the existence of a D&D House Style Guide distributed to creators is reported but not claimed. NOT FOUND — no publicly published Wizards of the Coast prose style guide exists at any lawful route I could reach; the nearest publisher-authored substitutes are Shawn Merwin's boxed-text column and the Free Rules paragraph. Substantive by route: 9 publisher primaries read raw (2 free adventure/handout PDFs, 2 SRD PDFs, the Free Rules section, the Phandalin Post handout text, 3 more), 8 official D&D Beyond articles and columns, 1 designer PDF recovered through the Wayback raw capture (Perkins's collected 2011 columns), 4 relays or reviews that quote or index the page (PC Gamer via Wayback, Gaming Nexus, Lex Starwalker, Tools and Taverns), and 6 sources logged non-substantive or blocked. Discovery stopped after two consecutive searches surfaced nothing new that was both lawful and on-angle. No archive.org or other full-book scan, and no Roll20 or purchase-gated body text, was used for any claim.
